<thought>First, I will define a diverse list of 40 oxide compositions. Then I will retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition with a maximum energy above hull of 0.3 eV/atom, saving the results in a dedicated directory. After retrieval, I will list the generated JSON files, map each composition to its file, and consolidate all files into a single dataset. Finally, I will return the path to the consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>

    "compositions": [
        "Fe2O3", "TiO2", "Al2O3", "SiO2", "ZnO", "CuO", "NiO", "CoO", "MnO", "Cr2O3",

    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
